20517f8bfe65af7f.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Sr. Lead Engineering Manager specializing in Telecom to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a specialist to provide technical leadership for the end-to-end conceptualization, design, selection, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of telecommunication networks. These networks are critical for enabling reliable, secure, and low-latency control, monitoring, metering, and data handling within power transmission systems, substations, and power generation plants. Key Responsibilities The Sr. Lead Engineering Manager will lead key tasks from the engineering office and provide support from the conceptual to the commissioning stage for both engineering and commissioning teams. Responsibilities include: Providing technical leadership for the conceptualization, design, selection, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of telecommunication networks. Developing engineering designs for telecommunication systems in substations and power transmission systems, including overhead transmission lines and UG cables. This involves selecting fiber characteristics, multiplexers, and interface cards for various external elements like protection relays, meters, Substation Automation Systems, and communication systems. Designing telecommunication systems for conventional and inverter-based generation plants, including selecting fiber characteristics, Ethernet switches, and time synchronization elements. Understanding project-specific requirements to conceptualize and develop detailed Telecom Network Architectures. Applying knowledge of OEM telecom products (Multiplexers, Ethernet switches, Fiber optics cables, GPS/GNSS) and their practical limitations in network architecture development. Performing traffic engineering for low-latency and low-jitter networks suitable for PPC/EMS control loops. Determining equipment ratings based on Telecom Budget calculations, with familiarity with products from OEMs such as Hitachi, GE, Siemens, Huawei, and ZTE. Defining requirements and developing detailed specifications for telecom systems. Providing necessary support for Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and guiding the commissioning team for field testing, including cold and hot commissioning of telecom systems. Technical Expertise and Network Engineering The role requires in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in various aspects of telecom network engineering, including: Understanding the purpose of equipment in transmission substations such as PPC, SCADA, RTU, Protection Relay, SCMS, SAS, PMU, and their telecom interface points. Knowledge of communication protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 101, IEC 104, IEC 61850, and GOOSE. Experience in selecting and evaluating GPS/GNSS systems meeting IRIG-B, PTP protocol, and familiarity with IEEE 1588 (PTP) and IEEE **** standards. Good knowledge and experience in Cyber security compliance checks and test acceptance for telecom requirements. Testing and Commissioning Support The manager will support field testing and commissioning activities, including: Telecom power autonomy and blackout recovery. Fiber link certification and validating loss budgets for critical paths. Backbone redundancy failover and PRP/HSR seamless redundancy tests. PTP/NTP stability tests and WAN connectivity. Time synchronization and cyber security checks. Modbus TCP/IP and/or IEC 104 transmission checks. Diagnostic and Troubleshooting Skills The role requires hands-on experience with diagnosing network performance using communication tools such as: Wireshark Packet capture Network Monitoring & diagnostics tools Different data formats, including data compressions like Comtrade. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in relevant telecommunication engineering roles. The role demands a strong technical background and proven leadership in managing complex telecom projects from conceptualization through commissioning.

2024786be25b851a.description: The Director – Organizational Development provides enterprise-wide leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and OD foundations across the group and its subsidiaries. Guide leadership teams through structural scenario modeling and future-state organization design. Approve and sponsor structural recommendations for leadership decision-making. Strategic Workforce Planning Leadership Own the enterprise workforce planning framework and annual/multi-year planning cycles in partnership with HRBPs and Finance. Experience working in group company environments with multiple subsidiaries . Strong background in strategic workforce planning, org design, and job evaluation . 20a786f4061fad90.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الحدود الشمالية بمدينة عرعر. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة بتحليل العينات، وإجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية وفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة، مع الالتزام الصارم بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام اليومي. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات بدقة. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها بشكل دوري. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على جميع عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات بشكل مستمر. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات فوراً. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل وتوثيق النتائج. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة للحفاظ على بيئة عمل مرتبة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات بمدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية في بيئة مخبرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

20de81bd1c710886.description: About Jeeny: Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Jeeny was established in 2014 as Easy Taxi. However, in 2016, it was revamped as Jeeny to cater to other services. Currently, we are operational in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. We have offices in Riyadh, Jeddah, Madinah, Amman, Lahore, and Karachi. About the Role: As our Customer Communications Lead , you’ll own how we communicate with riders and drivers across all channels. You’ll bring structure to competing communication needs, set clear prioritisation rules, and ensure customers receive the right message at the right time. You’ll also lead experimentation across content, tone, offers and communication journeys, using A/B testing and performance data to understand what works and continuously improve our messaging. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong judgement, stakeholder management and analytical thinking, and wants to help shape the future of more automated and personalised customer communications. Responsibilities: Own our communications register, the definitive record of every message we send, who receives it, why it exists, who owns it, when it fires and how success is measured. Govern communications across teams and channels. Set and enforce the rules for frequency caps, suppression, priority, eligibility and exit criteria centrally, rather than one campaign at a time. Arbitrate competing sends, deciding which message reaches a customer at a contested moment and documenting the rationale. Design and run the A/B testing programme across content, maintaining a test register so experiments never collide on the same audience. Define the KPI for every message and work with data and engineering to close the gaps where performance cannot currently be read.
